verdict.rationale: Qdrant documents a native distributed deployment mode in which multiple Qdrant services distribute data across peers to extend storage and increase stability. It also offers cluster management on Kubernetes through Private Cloud, and community users describe it as scaling well in production. missing for 10: detailed evidence of shard configuration and replication controls, resharding or rebalancing behavior, and independent hands-on reports specifically about multi-node clusters.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can scale beyond one node with sharding or distributed deployment

citations.quote: Qdrant supports a distributed deployment mode. In this mode, multiple Qdrant services communicate with each other to distribute the data across the peers to extend the storage capabilities and increase stability.
Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure.
Qdrant does one job and scales well.
